name: eli20
description: Creates visual explainers and sectioned HTML notebooks from substantial source material.

interface.shortDescription: Visual explainers and browsable HTML notebooks.
interface.longDescription: Turn complex topics into visual HTML explainers, or organize larger source material into a chapter-by-chapter notebook with a visual and summary for each section.
defaultPrompt: Use $eli20 to explain this topic as a visual HTML artifact.
Use $eli20-notebook to organize this source into a visual HTML notebook.
